privileged_info_for_vlm: The database 'demodb' is located at http://localhost:2480. The final report must be saved to /home/ga/analytics_report.txt and must be at least 50 bytes in size. The report must contain five distinct sections: Nationality Distribution (sorted), Average Hotel Stars (rounded to 2 decimals), 5-Star Hotel details, Restaurant counts, and Order Revenue (Sum, Avg, Count by Status).
